decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the well-accepted BASIC 518 trommel at the core of the firm's screening business, so its results likely meet the aspiration even though it has not been visible on the website since 2020.

The flail shredder line fits mobile processing but is a niche, and with no visibility since 2020 and little slack in a firm under pressure, it faces real pruning risk, though not enough yet to drop it.

Green waste is a core segment, but the firm already withdrew its other high-speed grinder line (C), and this low-visibility line may face the same problemistic search, so it is kept on the edge of the threshold.
The stationary pre-shredders support the plant business and the firm's shredding know-how, so the line is kept despite uncertain results and limited slack for non-core stationary lines.
